archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-identity
archetypes.rationale: The shared adapter now owns identity-seeded launch and reattachment across several implement routes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the custom merge-env and initial-row contract in bgjob model/adapt together with Step 5, Step 6, and checks callers. Focus on stale-result reuse, live reattachment, path safety, and whether child publication can lose or accept the wrong identity rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
